Chapter 364 - 364 Dream; Not The Largest Shareholder!

Chapter 364 - 364 Dream; Not the Largest Shareholder!

364 Dream; Not the Largest Shareholder!

The employees of Flower Stem chatted and laughed, the atmosphere extremely heated.

Even Chu Yunyue could not help but smile.

It had always been Chu Yunyue’s dream to make Flower Stem the world’s top perfume brand.

What happened this afternoon had taken her one big step closer to this dream!

“How many orders have we received in total?” Chu Yunyue asked.

“108,900 bottles!” the oval-faced woman said.

“Not bad!” Chu Yunyue nodded in satisfaction.

Then, she looked at Lin Fan curiously and asked, “Lin Fan, why can our Flower Stem’s perfume heal Princess Riley?”

Everyone in Flower Stem pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very curious about this matter.

They had seen it with their own eyes… At that time, Riley looked very pitiful.

Her face was pale, she had fainted, and she was foaming at the mouth…

Even the doctor did not seem to know what to do.

In the end, Lin Fan took out the Flower Stem’s perfume and placed it by Riley’s nose for her to sniff for half a minute. Immediately, she stopped foaming at the mouth and her complexion turned for the better.

When he fed Riley some liquid, she immediately woke up.

In the eyes of everyone, this was simply too unbelievable.

Lin Fan said, “Riley’s mother must’ve had a difficult birth. Riley’s body is weak, and she catches a cold easily.

“So, Eagle Country’s royal family placed her in a confined space for a long time and gave her a lot of supplements.

“However, a child’s body can’t absorb that many supplements. In addition, there was a long-term lack of air circulation… It caused problems in her respiratory system, digestive system, and so on.

“Riley had been sealed off from the world for a long time. Today, she walked for a long time in the exhibition center that was filled with different fragrances. This increased the burden on her respiratory system, which eventually caused her to fall ill.”

“If that’s the case, then why did she get better after smelling our perfume?” Chu Yunyue asked again.

“That’s because I took the wind series,” Lin Fan said.

“Mint was added to the wind series.”

Lin Fan was a perfume expert and knew all kinds of perfumes like the back of his hand. In addition, he had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience, so he easily came up with a simple treatment plan.

After hearing Lin Fan’s explanation, everyone’s faces lit up.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue seemed to have thought of something and asked, “By the way, why does the chairman of Eagle Country Oil Company know you and treat you so respectfully?”

“Don’t tell me you’re the boss of Eagle Country Oil Company or the largest shareholder?”

The oval-faced woman and the employees of Flower Stem perked up their ears again.

They were also very concerned about this.

“That’s not it,” Lin Fan said.

Chu Yunyue was slightly relieved after hearing what he had to say.

Lin Fan was already the owner of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel and the biggest shareholder of Xia Airlines.

What if he was also the boss or the largest shareholder of an oil company?

Their little hearts would be unable to accept it.

At this moment, Lin Fan continued, “I only have 10% of Eagle Country Oil Company’s shares. I can be considered their second-largest shareholder.”

Silence!

The entire scene was silent!

Chu Yunyue, the oval-faced woman, and the staff of Flower Stem were all stunned.

With 10% of Eagle Country Oil Company’s shares, he was the second-largest shareholder?

One had to know…

Eagle Country Oil Company was a super company with a market value of more than a trillion!

10% of the shares would be worth more than 100 billion!

It was true that Lin Fan was indeed not the biggest shareholder nor the boss.

However, 10% of the shares was a lot, alright?!

Lin Fan saw that everyone was in a daze and could not help but say, “What’s wrong with you guys? Let’s go. The food should be ready.”

“Ah… Alright, alright,” Chu Yunyue replied.

Then, the group continued to walk forward.

Just as Lin Fan said, the food was ready.

When they pushed open the VIP room, they saw very exquisite and sumptuous dishes placed neatly on the table.

Everyone was very busy today, and they were indeed a little hungry.

When they saw the delicacies, they all ate heartily.

When Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue returned to the luxurious suite, it was already an hour later.

They sat in front of the tall floor-to-ceiling windows that overlooked the busy road outside and the pitch-black river in the distance. They felt extremely relaxed.

It felt like they were not in Eagle Country but back at home in Jiangbei.

Home?

Chu Yunyue’s heart softened when she thought of this term.

She could not help but turn her head and look at Lin Fan. Her beautiful gem-like eyes flashed.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue could not help but think of Lin Fan’s use of perfume knowledge that far exceeded ordinary people. It allowed him to create a fascinating perfume.

She thought of Lin Fan picking up the microphone and singing a heavenly song.

She thought about how Lin Fan had used the perfume to save someone and how it had caused Flower Stem, which no one cared about, to become extremely popular…

These things were like scenes from a movie, rippling in Chu Yunyue’s mind.

Gradually, Chu Yunyue’s beautiful eyes went from shining to becoming a little dazed.

Then, she could not help but get closer to Lin Fan.

A strong wind blew outside the window, causing the river water to beat against the dam, making a crisp sound.

…

The next day, the sky was bright.

Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes. The entire suite was empty. There was a note on the table.

[Today is the last day of the perfume exhibition. I’ll go to the exhibition center first. Remember to have breakfast later! Mwacks! Chu Yunyue.]

When Lin Fan saw the note, the corners of his mouth curled up slightly. He could almost imagine Chu Yunyue’s sweet smile when she wrote the note.

Then, he glanced at his phone out of habit.

A text message appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,493,100 yuan was deposited into your account.]

“Let’s see what we can from signing in today,” Lin Fan muttered.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000,000 yuan.]

Lin Fan pursed his lips and said, “What bad luck.”

Then, he picked up the phone on the table and said, “Send some breakfast up.”

The best service was offered to Lin Fan’s luxurious suite.

Soon, truffle slices, toast, ham, M5 beef, black tea, and other exquisite breakfast dishes were served.

Lin Fan ate his breakfast while playing with his phone. He was very relaxed and satisfied.
